text: I call to order the Select Committee of the School Board for hearing appeals. Are there any motions on the floor? I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to 2-2-2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following purposes: Discussion

or consideration of matters that would involve disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely parent request for an LCPS student to attend a school outside of their assigned attendance zone, which is authorized by 2.2-3711.A2 of the Code of Virginia. Discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of

information contained in respective scholastic records concerning students, namely parents requesting permission by the staff for their respective students to be exerted or given early attendance at an existing school, but who missed the survey deadline as authorized by 2.2-3711A2 of the Code of Virginia. Thank you. We have a motion by Ms. Labelle. Is there a second? Second.

Thank you, Ms. Ricardi. It has been properly moved by Ms. Labelle and seconded by Ms. Ricardi. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. Seeing none opposed, that motion carries unanimously. With that, we are in closed session. All right. Ms. Labelle, do you have a motion? I do. I move to adjourn the closed meeting, that the Loudoun County School Board reconvene its public meeting, and that the

minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Is there a second? Second. Thank you. It has been properly moved by Ms. Labelle and seconded by Ms. Ricardi that we adjourn the closed meeting. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. Seeing none opposed, that motion passes unanimously. Ms. Labelle, do you have another motion? I do. I move that the following resolution certifying the closed

meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Resolution number 35-25/26. Whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act, and whereas code 2.2-3712D

of the Code of Virginia requires certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Loudoun County School Board hereby certifies that to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which this certification applies.

And two, only such public business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard, discussed, or considered by the Loudoun County School Board. Ms. Labelle has made a motion. Is there a second? Second. Thank you. It has been properly moved and seconded that this Select Committee certify the closed meeting. All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye.

Aye. Seeing none opposed, that motion passes unanimously. And finally, do we have a final motion? Yes, we do. I move that the Select Committee of the School Board's findings and decisions included in the attached table be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. Ms. Labelle has made a motion. Is there a second? Second. Thank you. It has been properly moved and seconded.

All those in favor, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. Seeing none opposed, that motion passes unanimously. And with that, we will move on to adjournment. This Select Committee of the School Board for Hearing Appeals
